key_points: RTX secured a multi‑year AMRAAM missile production contract worth up to $20.7 billion under the Arsenal of Freedom initiative.
A $50.1 million Navy repair order underscores sustained electronic‑warfare demand and supports the Next Generation Jammer program.
Defense analysts note rising AMRAAM and electronic‑warfare demand as tailwinds for RTX’s defense growth outlook.
Dividend discussion highlights RTX’s competitive yield and dividend‑growth track record versus peers.
Overall defense‑sector sentiment is positive, with RTX cited as a top near‑term watchlist candidate.
